wo-jpfa-JR4685.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu, Sidoarjo)

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

Sanitation Operator bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan kebersihan dan sanitasi fasilitas produksi PT Japfa Food Indonesia sesuai dengan standar kebersihan dan keamanan pangan yang berlaku.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

* Melaksanakan prosedur sanitasi dan pembersihan mesin produksi, peralatan, dan area kerja sesuai dengan standar operasional prosedur (SOP) yang ditetapkan.
* Memastikan semua peralatan dan area kerja bebas dari kontaminasi silang.
* Menggunakan bahan kimia pembersih dan desinfektan dengan benar dan aman.
* Melakukan inspeksi rutin terhadap kebersihan fasilitas dan melaporkan temuan atau penyimpangan kepada atasan.
* Mencatat dan mendokumentasikan semua aktivitas sanitasi dan pembersihan yang dilakukan.
* Menjaga ketersediaan dan kebersihan alat-alat kebersihan yang digunakan.
* Melaksanakan tindakan perbaikan segera jika ditemukan masalah sanitasi.
* Mematuhi semua peraturan kesehatan, keselamatan, dan lingkungan kerja yang berlaku.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

* Memahami prinsip-prinsip kebersihan dan sanitasi industri pangan. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
* Teliti, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab.
* Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.
* Memiliki fisik yang sehat dan kuat

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-jpfa-JR5215.d:
Job Summary
PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented PPIC (Production Planning and Inventory Control) Staff placement in Nganjuk.

Job Responsibilities:
* Formulate and implement production plans and schedules based on sales forecasts and capacity constraints.
* Monitor and control inventory levels of raw materials, packaging, and finished goods to prevent stockouts or overstock situations.
* Coordinate closely with the procurement department to ensure timely delivery of raw materials.
* Track production progress and analyze variances between planned schedules and actual output.
* Prepare regular reports on inventory status, production efficiency, and material usage for management review.
* Collaborate with warehousing and logistics teams to optimize storage space and streamline distribution processes.

Job Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in PPIC, production scheduling, or inventory control, preferably within the manufacturing or food processing industry.
* Strong proficiency in using ERP systems (such as SAP) and Microsoft Excel for data analysis.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication skills in both Indonesian and English.

wo-klbf-JR26_001667.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan dari atasan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

Company:
KSF PT. Kalventis Sinergi Farma

Job Description

- Shipment Execution: Execute the shipment process from preparation to the arrival of goods at the destination according to the established schedule.
- Shipping Coordination: Communicate with drivers, vendors, and third parties to ensure the smooth shipment of goods.
- Monitoring Shipment Status: Monitor the progress of goods and provide updates on the shipping status to relevant parties. Address issues or obstacles that arise during the shipping process.
- Administration and Documentation: Prepare and maintain documentation related to shipments, such as delivery notes, receipts, and daily reports.
- Safety Standards Compliance: Ensure all shipment processes are conducted according to applicable safety standards and adhere to regulations.
- Problem Resolution: Handle complaints or problems that may arise during the expedition process and strive to resolve them promptly.
- Collaboration with Other Teams: Work closely with warehouse, logistics, and transportation teams to ensure goods are properly loaded and shipped on schedule.

- Pelaksanaan Pengiriman: Melaksanakan proses pengiriman barang mulai dari persiapan hingga barang tiba di tujuan sesuai dengan jadwal yang telah ditetapkan.
- Koordinasi Pengiriman: Berkomunikasi dengan pengemudi, vendor, dan pihak ketiga untuk memastikan kelancaran proses pengiriman barang.
- Pemantauan Status Pengiriman: Memantau perjalanan barang dan memberikan pembaruan terkait status pengiriman kepada pihak terkait. Mengatasi masalah atau hambatan yang muncul selama proses pengiriman.
- Administrasi dan Dokumentasi: Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi terkait pengiriman, seperti surat jalan, tanda terima, dan laporan harian.
- Penerapan Standar Keselamatan: Memastikan seluruh proses pengiriman dilakukan sesuai dengan standar keselamatan yang berlaku dan mematuhi peraturan yang ditetapkan.
- Penanganan Masalah: Menangani keluhan atau permasalahan yang mungkin muncul selama proses ekspedisi dan berupaya untuk menyelesaikannya dengan cepat.
- Kolaborasi dengan Tim Lain: Bekerja sama dengan tim gudang, logistik, dan transportasi untuk memastikan barang diangkut dengan benar dan sesuai jadwal.

Company:
EPM PT. Enseval Putera Megatrading Tbk
